aircraft.source: Pre-existing world asset; preserved and instantiated, with runtime scale/orientation and canopy override.

experience: Simplified unarmed free flight, runway takeoff, safe-landing criteria, loss of lift at low speed, collisions, reset, gear, chase/cockpit cameras, optional seven-gate course.
continuity: Original sandbox, player and managed bridges remain intact. The flight SubViewport shares world physics without replacing the base camera. Aircraft state now participates in the existing craftmine_persistent_components ledger as j20-player-aircraft. Managed save/load owns durable storage, additive old-save defaults and atomic rollback; there is no independent local save file.
persistence: Versioned payload stores position, actual attitude and flight-control angles, velocity vector and airspeed, throttle, gear state and extension, camera mode/pose/FOV, assist, airborne/crashed state and course progress. Start resumes without reset; R explicitly resets. Opening screen has only Start, Back and operating hints.
verification: Independent real-controller JSON round-trip and continuation probes accompany ordinary host build/check. A passed check remains separate from adoption and a player save/exit/reentry test.
